items.prompt: A trade is marked filled by one report but absent from a local ledger. What would you check before retrying the order?
items.modelAnswer: Check account/instrument/order/execution identities, authoritative reports and cumulative fills, message sequence/duplicates/corrections and local commit/recovery status. Treat the outcome as uncertain; do not infer failure and duplicate the order.

criteria.text: Preserves identity and confirmed execution evidence.
Checks reconciliation/recovery rather than blind retry.
